unit_name: Defense Area La Rochelle (Verteidigungsbereich La Rochelle) garrison
current_activity: Defense Area La Rochelle left to hold out on the Atlantic coast; siege begins
notes: Event date: September 1944 (Wikipedia); 1 September is used (inferred value); Clarke and Smith (ch. 8) has the garrison left behind in late August. Event definition: Hitler directs that Defense Area La Rochelle be held to the end as the LXIV Corps withdraws (Clarke and Smith, ch. 8); the Allied siege lasts from September 1944 to May 1945 (Wikipedia). Event support: two source families (the US Army official history (CMH), and Wikipedia). Clarke and Smith, Riviera to the Rhine, ch. 8, p. 135: "Defense Area La Rochelle"; Wikipedia, Allied siege of La Rochelle: "The Allied siege of the pocket of La Rochelle lasted from September 1944 to May 1945". Location: La Rochelle, Charente-Maritime (new place) with a precision of 5 km. Location support: Clarke and Smith and Wikipedia both name La Rochelle.

unit_name: Defense Area La Rochelle (Verteidigungsbereich La Rochelle) garrison
current_activity: garrison surrenders; ceremony at 23:45 on 8 May
notes: Event date: 8 May 1945, 23:45 (Wikipedia); MacDonald (ch. 20) has the southwestern coast capitulating on 9 May. Event definition: La Rochelle is surrendered on 7 May with the ceremony on 8 May at 23:45 (Wikipedia, Allied siege of La Rochelle). Event support: one source family (Wikipedia). Wikipedia, Allied siege of La Rochelle: "with the surrender ceremony occurring on 8 May 1945, at 23:45". Location: La Rochelle, Charente-Maritime (new place) with a precision of 5 km. Location support: Wikipedia names La Rochelle.
